Our client is an established player in the pharmaceutical and chemical industry, involved in several ongoing projects within highly regulated environments. Due to continued project growth, they are looking for a Mechanical Qualification Engineer to strengthen their project teams.
 

In this role, you will focus on the technical verification and qualification of mechanical installations, equipment and utility systems, ensuring that all components meet the required engineering specifications, quality standards and GMP requirements. You will play an important role in verifying the mechanical integrity, installation quality and compliance of systems before they are released for operation.
 

Your Role As a Mechanical Qualification Engineer, you will be responsible for verifying and documenting the compliance of mechanical installations and process equipment throughout the project lifecycle. Your main focus will be on reviewing technical documentation, checking material and welding traceability, verifying installation records and witnessing mechanical and functional tests.
 

You will work closely with engineering, construction, commissioning and quality teams to ensure that all mechanical systems meet the applicable technical and regulatory requirements.
 

Your Responsibilities
 

* Review and verify mechanical qualification documentation, ensuring completeness and compliance with project specifications and GMP requirements. 
* Verify welding documentation, including weld logs, weld maps, welding procedures (WPS/PQR) and welder qualifications. 
* Review material certificates (EN 10204 3.1), material traceability and compliance with applicable material specifications. 
* Verify mechanical installations against P&IDs, isometric drawings, equipment specifications and engineering standards. 
* Review and verify pressure test reports, leak test documentation and mechanical inspection records. * Witness and document functional tests of mechanical equipment, including pumps, valves, reactors, vessels and heat exchangers. 
* Participate in FAT and SAT activities, verifying that mechanical requirements and acceptance criteria are fulfilled. 
* Execute and review mechanical qualification activities, including Installation Qualification (IQ) and Operational Qualification (OQ). 
* Identify, document and follow up on technical discrepancies, deviations and non-conformities. * Ensure that all mechanical qualification documentation is properly compiled and traceable within the project documentation package. 
* Collaborate with Engineering, QA, Construction and external contractors to ensure compliance with GMP, ASME BPE and applicable engineering standards.

* You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electromechanics, Chemical Engineering or an equivalent technical discipline. 
* You have experience in mechanical qualification, mechanical quality control, commissioning or inspection within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or chemical industry. 
* You have a good understanding of GMP requirements and qualification principles. 
* You are comfortable reviewing technical documentation such as P&IDs, isometric drawings, material certificates, welding documentation and mechanical test reports. 
* You have a good understanding of mechanical installations, piping systems, welding standards, material traceability and equipment testing. 
* Experience with IQ/OQ documentation, FAT and SAT activities is considered an advantage. 
* You work accurately and systematically, with a strong focus on quality, compliance and documentation. 
* You are proactive, detail-oriented and confident in identifying and challenging technical discrepancies. * You communicate effectively with technicians, engineers, suppliers and Quality teams. 
* You are fluent in English. Dutch is considered an advantage.
